# KeyValue&lt;K, V&gt;

One entry of a map, as a value a caller can hold.

```rux
pub struct KeyValue<K, V> {
    pub key: K;
    pub value: V;
}
```

What a walk yields and what a consuming iteration hands back. Two fields rather than a pair, because `entry.key`
says which is which and `entry.0` does not.

## Type parameters

| Name | Description    |
| ---- | -------------- |
| `K`  | the key type   |
| `V`  | the value type |

## Fields

| Name    | Type | Description                         |
| ------- | ---- | ----------------------------------- |
| `key`   | `K`  | The key the entry was stored under. |
| `value` | `V`  | The value stored under it.          |
